components.name: Primary Button

components.name: Native Field

components.css: .ds-field{display:block;font-weight:600;color:var(--ink,#2d2a26);font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif;font-size:14px;line-height:1.4;}.ds-input{display:block;width:100%;min-height:40px;margin-top:8px;padding:10px 12px;border:1px solid var(--control-border,#8e877e);border-radius:8px;background:var(--input,#ffffff);font:inherit;font-weight:400;color:inherit}.ds-input:hover{border-color:var(--muted,#68625b)}.ds-input:focus{outline:none;border-color:var(--focus,#59564f);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px var(--focus-ring,rgb(89 86 79 / 18%)))}.ds-input::placeholder,.ds-hint{color:var(--muted,#68625b)}.ds-hint{display:block;margin-top:8px;font-size:13px;font-weight:400}@media(max-width:600px){.ds-input{font-size:16px;min-height:44px}}

components.name: Task Navigation

components.css: .ds-tabs{display:flex;gap:2px;overflow-x:auto;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border,#dedbd4)}.ds-tab{position:relative;flex-shrink:0;min-height:40px;border:0;border-radius:8px 8px 0 0;padding:8px 12px 11px;background:transparent;color:var(--muted,#68625b);font-weight:550;cursor:pointer;font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif;font-size:14px;line-height:1.4;}.ds-tab:after{content:"";position:absolute;left:10px;right:10px;bottom:0;height:2px;background:transparent}.ds-active{color:var(--ink,#2d2a26);font-weight:650}.ds-active:after{background:var(--ink,#2d2a26)}.ds-tab:hover{background:var(--hover,#f0ede6)}.ds-tab:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--focus,#59564f);outline-offset:-3px}.ds-tab:active{filter:brightness(.94)}@media(max-width:600px){.ds-tab{min-height:44px}}

components.name: Saved Rule Switch
components.description: A native checkbox presented as the host-sized switch; the form save applies its draft.
components.css: .ds-switch{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;min-height:44px;color:var(--ink,#2d2a26);font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif;font-size:14px;line-height:1.4;}.ds-switch input{appearance:none;position:relative;flex:0 0 44px;width:44px;height:24px;margin:0;border:1px solid var(--control-border,#8e877e);border-radius:24px;background:var(--input,#ffffff);cursor:pointer}.ds-switch input:before{content:"";position:absolute;top:2px;left:2px;width:18px;height:18px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--muted,#68625b);transition:transform 200ms ease-out}.ds-switch input:checked{background:var(--accent,#59564f);border-color:var(--accent,#59564f)}.ds-switch input:checked:before{transform:translateX(20px);background:var(--on-accent,#ffffff)}.ds-switch input:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--focus,#59564f);outline-offset:3px}.ds-switch input:disabled{opacity:.5;cursor:not-allowed}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-switch input:before{transition:none}}@media(forced-colors:active){.ds-switch input{appearance:auto}.ds-switch input:before{display:none}}

narrative.overview: Model Quality keeps the CPA warm light, white and dark family with lighter working surfaces, stronger primary actions, consistent navigation and status treatment. The compact manual layout preserves editor/action alignment and the header connection entry. Results, rules and operations size to content; editors and confirmations share a consistent spacing rhythm. Credential-wide pause semantics are unchanged.
keyCharacteristics: Separate page, card, input, floating and hover roles in all three themes.
Host system type, eight-pixel controls and twelve-pixel surfaces with compact 16px card padding.
Configuration and current answers share the page by default; explicit expanded reading preserves the mounted configuration draft.
First-viewport configuration, primary actions and answer opening; local scrolling for long prompts, results and rule editor bodies.
Attention and credential restrictions share desktop columns; statistics remain secondary.
Independent labels for execution, quality, rule state and credential restrictions.

rules.name: The Host Component Rule
rules.body: Use the fixed CPA plugin-management page and shared primitives as the visual authority. Adapt contrast and responsive dimensions explicitly; preserve the host role and interaction contract.

rules.name: The Separate State Rule
rules.body: Execution, answer quality, rule enablement and credential restrictions are different facts. Pair color with precise text and never derive one state from another.

rules.name: The Reading Continuity Rule
rules.body: Polling updates changed evidence without replacing stable drafts, focused controls, selections, disclosures or reading positions. Local view switches preserve the mounted configuration form.

rules.name: The Bounded Release Rule
rules.body: Show the exact owned pause, identity, action version, consequences and remaining restrictions together. Keep conflict and uncertain outcomes visible until reconciled.

rules.name: The First Viewport Rule
rules.body: Keep normal desktop configuration, primary actions and the start of answers visible together. Use local scrolling for unbounded content, and restore document flow on narrow or short viewports instead of clipping controls or reducing readable type.

dos: Do use the role tokens and all three theme mappings for every shared component.
Do begin with the fixed CPA plugin-management and shared-component references when extending the interface.
Do preserve visible labels, keyboard focus, native dialogs, draft state and reduced-motion behavior.
Do keep ordinary text readable, phone input at least 16px and main touch targets at least 44px.
Do keep unknown values explicit and preserve original answers for copy and export.
Do check embedded and standalone layouts with actual iframe widths and complete data states.
Do keep configuration and primary actions in the desktop first viewport; let long content scroll locally and short or narrow windows use document flow.
donts: Don't duplicate the host sidebar, global tools or authentication state.
Don't use the floating-surface color as an ordinary card default.
Don't turn successful completion or manual release into an unearned quality or availability claim.
Don't turn a long rule editor into a confirmation modal.
Don't repaint the whole reading surface on polling or move the reader's focus.
Don't execute model-generated content in the parent page or relax the preview sandbox.
Don't hide overflow or shrink text to claim that unlimited content fits without scrolling.
